decisions.reason: This custom earmold remains very close to the firm's established hearing-technology knowledge base, and another year on the market increases confidence that the firm can keep improving it rather than withdraw it.
The custom in-ear earmold is tightly connected to the firm's existing products, customers, and in-house R&D, so absorptive capacity for incremental refinement and support is strong.
The vacuum thermoforming unit fits the firm's established equipment, materials, and laboratory workflow capabilities, making continued development and commercialization more likely than exit.

The orthopedic shoe last is comparatively distant from the firm's core dental and hearing-medical technology competencies, so limited absorptive capacity makes redeploying resources more attractive than persisting with it.
The post-curing unit builds on the firm's digital manufacturing, lab-process, and medical-device production know-how, giving it a credible path for learning and improvement after launch.
